releaseNotes: Eclipse Companion 1.1.2 repairs corrupted interface text and Arabic camera guidance, adds proper Arabic translations for the new screens, and makes NASA Mission Control the default theme. The home screen now has one featured eclipse-map mission and five clear operational rows instead of duplicated card grids. The 20 additional interface languages are bundled as on-demand offline chunks, reducing the startup JavaScript bundle from about 1.79 MB to 444.57 KB. Existing learning, simulator, professional and phone camera guides, observation planner and journal, safety tools, public-place viewing finder, and offline assistant remain included.
